comment: Input 16, the clock input, has no jack on this free version's panel and is left untagged; clock sync is a ShapeMaster Pro feature. The two length params, sync and unsync, share one knob position, so both are tagged to the length line. What a channel trigger input expects depends on that channel trigger mode: in Trig and Gate modes it is a gate read by a rise-and-fall trigger that turns on at 1V, and in CV mode it is the playhead position read as 0 to 10V, or as -5 to 5V when the channel is set to bipolar CV. The clock input is declared and read but the installed build gives it no clickable position.
